repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `baa9e0e0fb2a6bf05f3f2c9089932a037567a307` · 2026-11-26T00:54Z

Card #37261 → PR #37357. Read at head `baa9e0e0`: the card and its 4 comments, the PR body, the flake comment 7178743910 (2026-11-26T00:25Z), the zone's finalized-head note 7179025988 on the card (2026-11-26T00:41Z, the report of record), and the full net diff (3 files, +93 / −21).

**Checklist**

- **Shape** (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37357`, exit 0, 13 items, none flagged). The PR is open, a draft and targets `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #37261`, and no closing keyword binds any other card. `Fixes` is right: merging delivers the whole card (see Done-when below).
- **Done-when holds.** Both entry points now go through one rule. The package is resolved by the same function as for a view, `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`. It gets the same input as the view leg: `useRuntimeCreateApp` computes `draftBarPackageOf(appName, apps)` from `useParams` and `useMetadata`, and `ReportNewPage.tsx:129` computes the same expression from the same two hooks.
  - The fallback notice now fires on `appPackageId && !packageId` (`ReportNewPage.tsx:165`). That is the same expression as `createRuntimeMetadata`'s `app?.packageId && !packageId` (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:485`), because `app.packageId` is that same `draftBarPackageOf` value.
  - The guard `studioReturn ?` on the resolve call and the guard `studioReturn &&` on the notice are both gone. With no app, `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` returns `null` early, so the report is saved with no package and no notice is shown. A view does the same.
- **The card's warning item was already delivered.** The card also asked to reword the console warning. `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` already says ``the ${type} is saved naming no package``: it reads that way at the merge base `98bda0ac` (line 216), and `git log -S` traces it to #37226 (`ff049430`). The PR body says so. Nothing in this item is left open.
- **The replaced pin is justified.** The card asks for this in its own words: "Replace the existing pin that holds the old package-less behaviour outside Studio (added by #36906), and name it in the PR."
  - The PR names the pin: *Save creates and publishes the report and lands on its page; nothing speaks of a menu*.
  - It removes only that pin's #36906 assertions that the report saves with no package outside Studio, which this card reverses. It keeps the navigation and no-menu assertions, and now asserts one save and one publish.
  - The new describe pins where the report is saved in that leg. The default `beforeEach` lists `PKG` as writable, so the replacement is the writable-package case.
- **Scope.** The 3 files are `ReportNewPage.tsx`, `ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx` and `.changeset/37261-app-new-report-package.md`. All are inside the claim's file surface, and there is no route change and no migration of stored reports.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so no changeset is required. The changeset follows the package's existing practice, and `check:changeset-fixed` is green in CI.
  - I read the changeset sentence by sentence against the diff, and each holds. These are the three behaviour bullets: the writable package or the customization package, the no-package fallback with its notice, and existing reports not moved. The example in "for example, the deployment does not let a tenant administrator create one" is the 403 case that the CONTROL pin drives.
  - The source comment's "Outside any app it names no package, as a view does" is also true (the early `null` above).
- **Merging main left the PR's own changes intact.** The branch's own patch `fbb62e1c..9ded3000` is identical to the net patch `98bda0ac..baa9e0e0` (compared with `index` lines removed). The 3 blobs at head equal those at `9ded3000`. The 24 merged main commits touch none of the 3 files, nor `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx` or `DraftPreviewBar.tsx`.
- **Pins at head.** I ran them in a throwaway worktree at `baa9e0e0`, after building the CI "Build UI Deps" closure. `ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx` gave `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). Each mutation landed, and each restore was verified as blob == HEAD `167448556f0e` with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
  - A1 puts the `studioReturn ?` gate back on the resolve call: **4 failed** | 12 passed. Red: the replaced pin, the writable-package pin, the read-only pin and CONTROL.
  - A2 limits the notice to Studio again: **1 failed** | 15 passed. Red: CONTROL.
  - A3 deletes the notice line: **2 failed** | 14 passed. Red: CONTROL here and the Studio leg's control.
  - A4 is my own: it forces the no-package save (`const outcome = false`). **5 failed** | 11 passed. Red: the replaced pin, the writable-package and read-only pins, and the Studio leg's two in-package pins.
  - The dev's A1, A2 and A3 readings (4, 1 and 2 failed) reproduce exactly.
- **Declarations.** `readClause2Line` reads the card's newest `Claim:` comment, 7169110191 (the only one), as `{kind: declared, value: no}`. It reads the PR body the same way, and the changeset carries `Clause-②: no` too. `readMetadataProtocolLine` reads `none` on both. Claim and body agree.
- **Is a contract review owed? No.** No path is in `packages/spec/src/**` or on the governed surface. `Clause-②` is `no`, with no `(narrowing)` arm, and no public surface changes (no export, prop or type moves; the change is inside `handleSave`). There is no `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` or `TIER_DEFAULT` record, and there is no `record.md`.
- **Tier S.** No governed path, and 114 changed lines (under 3,000). So the Tier H final package is not owed.
- **Check-runs at head** (`filter=latest`): 51 runs, **38 success · 13 skipped · 0 failed · 0 pending**. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`. The only failures are the superseded attempt-1 rows Test UI (1/16) job 139594901092 and its Test UI aggregate. Attempt 2 of run 45725391000 has both green (139605091386 at 2026-11-26T00:37Z; aggregate 139609598753).
- **The flake reading is sound** (with N1).
  - Both failures are `Test timed out in 15000ms` with no assertion failing, on a slow shard (Duration 872 s).
  - Attempt 2 ran on the same head, with the same shard and the same 438 files. Both tests passed there: `check-vi-mock-specifiers.test.ts` 35 tests in 9.7 s, `dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` 37 tests in 12.1 s, 10945/10945 overall.
  - In my worktree at head, the two files pass 72/72 in 16.4 s.
  - The diff adds no `vi.mock` call and no `$`-dialect text, which is all those two gates judge.
- **Merge-tree against current origin/main** `d558de0a`: `git merge-tree --write-tree` exits 0 (tree `2bad7915`), with no conflicts.
- **K = 4.** That is `git rev-list --count --first-parent 98bda0ac..origin/main`, where `98bda0ac` is the merge's main parent and the merge base. See N2 for why this is a fallback reading. Neither other leg applies: the PR touches no `translations/` or `locales/` label surface, and no `skills/**` or `ui/**/locales/en.ts` budget book.
- **维护者速读 is accurate.** It has four lines and no code names, paths, commands or bare card numbers.
  - 「可写的应用存进应用自己的包;已安装(只读)的应用存进它的定制包」 matches the writable and `.custom` arms.
  - 「已有的报表不搬动」 matches the diff: only the target of a new report's first save changes.
  - 「从 Studio 打开的新建报表已经按这条规则存」 is true since #37226.
  - The failure mode 「或不属于任何包,这时 Studio 列表里看不到它」 matches the fallback and its notice.
  - 「要你做什么:无」 is right for a Tier S PR that owes no contract review.

**Findings**

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 — The flake comment's premise "Neither reads this PR's three files" is not literally true. Both gates walk `git ls-files` (`check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs:307`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census.mjs:356`), so they do read `ReportNewPage.tsx` and its test file. The verdict still stands on the other evidence: a wall-clock timeout with no failing assertion, the same head green in attempt 2, a 72/72 local pass, and a diff that adds nothing either gate judges. Next time, say "reads them, and judges nothing the diff added". No action on this PR.
- N2 — `landing-k.mjs --pr 37357` exits 3 (CAN'T ANSWER). The only green run, 45725391000, ran no Test Core shard, because this PR is UI-only, so no `Affected-set diff base` was printed. K = 4 above is the merge-base reading, used instead of PRBASE. The zone's note gave K = 3 at 2026-11-26T00:41Z, but main is 4 first-parent commits past the merge base now. Both readings are far below 15, so this changes nothing about landing. The note also says main was merged "at 00:2xZ", but the merge commit is stamped 2026-11-25T23:42Z. That is cosmetic.

**Landing**

- The zone lands it. K = 4 < 15, so there is no main merge first. Take a fresh `landing-k` or merge-base K reading at arming time. Then `pr_ready` and auto-merge, through the usual landing round.

- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The report of record is the dev session's final messages, summarised in the finalized-head note on #37261.
